needed.suggestion: Expand the sidewalk to improve accessibility on the left side.
Remove obstructions from the footway on the left side.
Repair the uneven sections on the right footway to prevent trip hazards.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing where people have to cross.
Enhance visibility of pedestrian crossings by adding signs or markings.
Increase street lighting to improve safety during low visibility.
